original_test_intent: Verify interoperability between BMC Web user creation and the Redfish AccountService representation: a newly created temporary account initially requires a password change, then an authorized password update clears `PasswordChangeRequired` while preserving the intended account identity and role.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify BMC firmware/AccountService schema and current account inventory; approve a unique temporary least-privilege username, initial/second secret policy and independent recovery admin; create the account once through BMC Web User Management as written; locate its exact Redfish account URI by stable ID; GET and parse the full account resource, requiring `PasswordChangeRequired=true`; PATCH only the Password property using protected secret input and validated TLS; GET again, requiring false and unchanged identity/role/enabled state; optionally perform one approved login; delete/disable the account and verify audit/cleanup without exposing either secret.
manual_activity: An operator approves the temporary account, role, secrets, WebUI creation and cleanup under an independent recovery administrator; an agent may perform the exact Redfish GET/PATCH/GET after approval with secret-safe handling.
required_inputs: BMC/SUT firmware, AccountService schema and exact WebUI User Management behavior
Unique temporary username, least-privilege role, Enabled/Locked expectations and cleanup/final state
Password policy and securely injected compliant initial/new secrets; never the literal Master example
Stable WebUI-user-to-Redfish-account URI mapping, TLS trust, authorized recovery admin and audit access
safety_requirements: Prove the selected username is unused and preserve a separate verified administrator/recovery path
Create only the approved least-privilege temporary account through the source-required WebUI path
Keep secrets out of URLs, process listings, shell history, command output, screenshots and artifacts
PATCH only the mapped temporary account and verify identity/role before and after
Stop on collision, wrong URI/role, lockout, unexpected policy change, flag anomaly or cleanup failure; do not retry credentials blindly
agent_execution_scope: Correlate the WebUI-created account to one exact Redfish resource
Collect redacted GET responses and verify PasswordChangeRequired true before and false after one approved secret update
Check unrelated properties remain stable and confirm deletion/disable cleanup
Do not invent/use a password, create through Redfish in place of WebUI, expose secrets, modify another account or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve temporary username/role/enabled state and both secret-generation/policy constraints
Approve expected PasswordChangeRequired behavior for WebUI-created account and Redfish PATCH semantics
Approve TLS/secret injection, optional login, deletion/disable cleanup and independent recovery
Review transition and cleanup evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Redfish POST/GET demonstrates account creation generically but does not preserve the source's BMC Web creation or its explicit GET-true, PATCH-password, GET-false sequence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Create the approved account through WebUI; then use secret-safe authenticated Redfish GET on the exact account URI, one Password-only PATCH with protected input, a second GET, and approved DELETE/disable cleanup. Never use `-k`, credentials in URLs or the literal password.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI account creation, account `test1` as a non-authoritative example, PasswordChangeRequired true-to-false checks, Redfish GET/PATCH/GET and 10/10-minute estimate remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction record keyed by the generated temporary username and Redfish Member ID, verify a minimal property diff around one protected password PATCH, then remove/disable the account and confirm no residual privilege.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds least privilege, unique identity, secret-safe transport, TLS validation, property-diff checks, audit correlation, cleanup and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful account POST or list entry does not prove WebUI-to-Redfish interoperability or the required PasswordChangeRequired state transition; changing a password without binding the URI can affect another account.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some BMCs expose usernames and Member IDs differently or force password change through a login flow rather than administrative PATCH, so project-supported semantics must be approved before mutation.

project_override_considerations: If this BMC does not support administrative Password PATCH to clear the flag, engineering must approve the supported first-login workflow without losing the true-to-false coverage. A Redfish POST may be separate supplemental coverage but cannot silently replace the source's WebUI account creation.
expected_evidence: BMC/firmware/AccountService policy and independent recovery-admin readiness
Approved temporary username/role and WebUI creation status without secrets
Exact account URI/Member ID plus redacted first GET showing PasswordChangeRequired true
Secret-safe PATCH HTTP/status metadata and redacted second GET showing false with stable identity/role
Optional approved login result, BMC security/audit entries and cleanup DELETE/disable verification
No-secret/no-unrelated-change audit, recovery events and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, WebUI creation and Redfish flag/update steps form a coherent cross-interface account test. DeepSeek's proposed POST is an incomplete substitution, not a conflict within Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The account lifecycle and required flag transition are explicit. Account policy, secure secrets, exact URI mapping and cleanup are expected project prerequisites, so the case is conditionally executable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2239 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00021-V001: approve BMC/firmware/AccountService and WebUI behavior, a unique temporary least-privilege username/role/enabled state, compliant securely generated initial/new secrets, WebUI-user-to-Redfish Member URI mapping, expected PasswordChangeRequired=true after creation and false after supported password change, TLS/secret injection, optional login, audit, deletion/disable cleanup, final state and independent recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the source's WebUI-to-Redfish interoperability and exact flag transition while eliminating the hardcoded password, wrong-interface substitution and account-lockout exposure.
independent_technical_reasoning: The meaningful coverage is not simply that Redfish can create an account; it is that an account created by the WebUI is represented with a forced-change flag and that the supported password update clears only that flag on the same principal. Account Member IDs may not equal usernames, so stable URI correlation is essential before PATCH. Credentials in the source's URL/literal examples are unsafe and must be replaced with protected secret input without changing the functional sequence. Cleanup and a separate administrator are required because an error can change management access control.
